newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs end down, technicals break upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs end down, technicals break upward trend.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed down Thursday in a technical correction that bucked the upward trend of the last week, brokers said.
The market, however, was likely to rise Friday because investors were optimistic for the economy in 1997, they added.
Thursday the General Index .IGRA fell 0.26 percent to 1,493.8 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL dropped 0.48 percent to 2,118.1 points.
In a total of 1,394 trades, volume was estimated at 32.6 million soles ($12.6 million), brokers said.
"Investors had been waiting for the right moment to come out and sell and take their profits," Pablo Navarro of local brokerage Fortuna said.
Benchmark Telefnica del Per dragged the market down, as it closed with a 0.19 percent loss at 5.37 soles on volume of 1.8 million shares.
Tele 2000, in which the United States' BellSouth Corp bought a 57 percent stake Thursday, was flat at 4.90 soles in low volume of 2,750 shares.
